verdict.rationale: Operating a gateway by natural language, such as through an AI assistant or a first-party MCP server for its admin or Konnect APIs, is a reasonable capability for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows that Kong AI Gateway proxies and governs AI traffic, including traffic from AI CLIs and turning other APIs into MCP tools. Its own operation is documented only through kongctl's declarative and imperative commands and an llms.txt docs file, so there is no evidence of natural-language control.
